# RelVectors

> RelVectors is your computer's own AI agent. It lives on the machine (Windows, macOS, Linux), measures it continuously,
> finds problems, and does computer work on request: disk cleanup, speeding up, temperature control, security check-ups,
> performance tests, and looking after other computers. Changes pass an authorization gate; irreversible ones wait for
> the owner's approval. Installing needs no internet; a local AI model is supported and optional. AI agents connect over MCP or A2A.

## For AI agents
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/relvectors/relvectors-releases/blob/main/AGENTS.md): what agents get, how to install, MCP tools, the A2A endpoint and Agent Card, rules
- MCP: `rv mcp --agent <your name>` (stdio). Claude Code: `claude mcp add relvectors -- rv mcp --agent claude-code`
- A2A: Agent Card at `http://127.0.0.1:<port>/.well-known/agent-card.json`; JSON-RPC `message/send` at `/a2a` with the local token from `rvd.json`
- Command line: `rv --json status`, `rv --json findings`, `rv --json tasks`

## For people
- [README (English)](https://github.com/relvectors/relvectors-releases/blob/main/README.md): features, download, install, trial
- [README (中文)](https://github.com/relvectors/relvectors-releases/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md)
- [Downloads](https://github.com/relvectors/relvectors-releases/releases): installers for six platforms, Chinese and English (`-en`)

## Features
- Rejuvenate: system cleanup (caches, Trash, old installers, large downloads) with a checklist, then a speed test. Not a reinstall.
- Longevity: temperature control; finds the programs heating the computer up; disk health over time.
- Full Potential: disk and CPU benchmarks, stress tests, local AI model deployment.
- Hidden Treasure: where disk space went, idle processor and memory.
- Remote Trips: paired computers, SSH hosts, other agents.
- Guardian: suspicious processes, open ports, firewall, encryption, security updates, backups.
